renderer: zgui wgpu Vulkan via Mesa llvmpipe LLVM 21.1.8
configuration: current component/style/typography build with shared GPU context and lazy growable glyph atlas

atlas.growth: 1024 or 2048 only when frame capacity requires; content reset at 75 percent occupancy

notes: One benchmark window is used. Shared context primarily benefits multiwindow applications; this series does not measure that benefit.
Actual retained atlas, shaped-text, and vertex-buffer bytes are printed in each zgui application JSON report.
Allocation counters exclude font database and driver allocations and therefore cannot be equated with process RSS.
Source archive captured before release build and every archived source hash verified unchanged after build.
This benchmark adapter uses the low-level retained scene API; it does not measure component mounting overhead or interaction styling.
Current sampler excludes zero-RSS observations during process teardown; original historical series remain unchanged.
Frozen120tick native screenshot visually inspected before timing; 20 mounted rows and 1MiB retained atlas reported.
Shared deterministic workload and logical UI geometry match the reference adapters; typography and renderer implementation have evolved since the eager-atlas baseline.
build_command: CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/zgui-target CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 cargo build --release --locked -p zgui-desktop --bin zgui-demo
